items.source:
Useful to defer application initialization until a database has started up.
Particularly appropriate for waiting on a slowly starting Oracle database.
items.translation: 可用于将应用程序初始化推迟到数据库启动之后。特别适用于等待缓慢启动的 Oracle 数据库。

items.source: Set the interval between validation runs (in seconds). Default is 1.
items.translation: 设置验证运行之间的间隔（以秒为单位）。默认值为1。

items.source: Set the timeout (in seconds) after which a fatal exception will be thrown. Default is 60.
items.translation: 设置致命异常将在多少秒后抛出（以秒为单位）。默认为60。

items.source: in favor of the JDBC 4.0 connection validation
items.translation: 支持 JDBC 4.0 连接验证

items.source:
Check whether the validation query can be executed on a Connection
from the specified DataSource, with the specified interval between
checks, until the specified timeout.
items.translation: 检查是否可以在指定的 DataSource 的 Connection 上执行验证查询，并在指定的检查间隔内，直到指定的超时时间。
将 DataSource 设置为验证模式。

items.source: Set the SQL query string to use for validation.
items.translation: 设置用于验证的 SQL 查询字符串。

items.source: Set the interval between validation runs (in seconds).
items.translation: 设置验证运行之间的间隔（以秒为单位）。

items.source:
Set the timeout (in seconds) after which a fatal exception
will be thrown.
items.translation: 设置超时时间（以秒为单位），超过该时间后将抛出致命异常。
